posts.title: Out in the trenches
posts.body:
Querying is a patience exercise, and I am not a patient person — but The Last Druid is out in the world now, sitting in a few inboxes while I try not to refresh my email every ten minutes.

In the meantime, Rising Tide is keeping me busy. Chapter nine fought back. Chapter nine lost.

posts.title: The outline finally holds
posts.body:
Rising Tide's outline is finally holding together. I rewrote the middle three times, mostly because Kazumi refused to cooperate with the version where she stayed behind.

She was right, of course. She usually is.

posts.title: Book one is done
posts.body: Book one is done. Actually done — not "done except for one more pass" done. Sekari has been living in my head for years and it's a strange feeling to hand it over to other people now.
